verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab has merge requests (its pull-request equivalent) with code review: agents review code in MRs, projects can set MR review standards, and the GitHub importer preserves pull requests and review comments. However, nothing explicitly documents diff comparison or inline, line-level comments alongside the code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of diff comparison views, explicit documentation of inline line-level review comments, hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a pull request, compare diffs, and leave inline review comments alongside the code

citations.quote: Agents turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code while your team stays in control.
Create MR review instructions to ensure consistent and specific code review standards in your project.
You can trigger an external agent directly from a discussion, issue, or merge request.
the GitHub importer brings over repo data, description, issues, pull requests, wiki pages, milestones, labels, release notes, review comments
